title: Agnostic Asks Muslim A Very Difficult Question! Muhammed Ali
normalized_text: – Bryce, how can I help you? – Hi, I'm a person with a disability. I'm also Christian And I guess my question is, why did God -or Allah in your case- give people disabilities? Why do we have disabilities? why do we.. Why am I born with a mental disability? OK, sure. First thing I would say, there's a lot of things that we do as human beings that do influence.. the disabilities that appear in people when they're born. For instance, like you have women, and you have a lot of people who would smoke while they're pregnant, and that can have an influence on the baby, on the child. There're people who can have bad habits while they're pregnant, or they can have things that causes also.. generational problematic things in genes, which also causes in the end disability. So to attribute these issues only to The Creator, I"d say is not fair, because there's many, many things that people do that also has an influence on the issues that happens to someone after their birth. So that's the first thing I'm going to say. Second thing I'm going to say is that this life is a test And Allah knows what is an appropriate test for everyone. And tests for people are different. My test is different than your test. It's different to someone else's test. And Allah knows you. He knows your nature. He created you. You're His servant. And He knows what tests you're able to handle, and what tests I'm able to handle. And He is going to give you that which befits you. And the reason is this life is not an eternal life. This life is just, we exist here for only a period of time. So whichever life we exist in, or whichever circumstances we have, is the test that we're given. And then once we pass that, this is the real life that will happen. Allah says "the Akhira" is the حيوان (al'Akabut29:64) The Akhirah (The Hereafter) is the real life THE AKHIRA IS THE ETERNAL REAL LIFE This life.. it's just like a traveler, you went, you stayed for a second in a city, and then moved to another city And if you travel, and spend two days in a city, you're not going to buy, and build, and do all of these things Because you're just going to leave. You're not going to start a bank.. No! You know you're here for a very small period of time, and you're going to leave somewhere else So that test that Allah is giving you specifically is that. And the test that Allah has given other people is different. The question is, are we going to succeed in that test or not? And there are people in way worse situations than you, and me for sure Like today, and we observe them today, may Allahﷻ (Mighty and Sovereign is He) be with them, Our brothers and sisters in Gaza for example! You've seen just recently circulated footage of people burning alive! You can see the father's trying to save the daughter, and him burning in the fire! You look at this, and you think this is not real life. You think it's existing in a movie or something! But this is this life. That there is good and evil, and there are evil people in this world There are good people in this world. And this is what we will be tested with. Are we going to succeed in that test? And understand that this is not it. It's just a period of time, and I'm going to leave from here. And if I do the right thing, then I have succeeded This is, I think, the mentality that everyone should have I got you Well, I guess my thing is that like, I know in the Bible or somewhere it says that for me, people with disabilities, have sinned or something in the past life or something.. I don't agree with that – I don't know if it says that in the Quran? – No! But I know that in the Bible or somewhere it says that So I was just making sure it wasn't something that I did in a past life or something No, no, we don't.. This is the thing. In Islam, unlike Christianity, which gives you the idea of the original sin and you're suffering for the sin of Adam, we don't believe in that. As Muslims, we believe you come into this life with a clean slate. There's nothing that's done before that you are suffering the sins of or you're responsible for. There's no such thing In this life, you're only responsible for what you're doing right now. There's no previous life. And the next life is the eternal life, which is after resurrection. It's an actual existence in life. There's no previous life There's no accountability that you're suffering for something.. and that's why it makes no sense even. – You're like: "I wasn’t in there. I don't remember that" – Yeah I didn't do anything wrong! Why am I suffering for what these people are telling me I have done? – Yeah, so it makes zero sense because it's not true – Yeah And the Creator is a Merciful God, and He only holds you accountable for what you do – And not for what other people do – Yeah Allahﷻ says in the Quran (alisraa17:15) وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ (A soul shall not bear the burden of another soul) – You only bear the burden and responsibility – I see – of what you choose to do – Yeah, thank you.. And then I have a question. Do you guys believe animals have souls? Yes... Yeah! The animals do have souls. Yes – And that's why.. – Yes. And that's something I've been struggling with.. – I'm sorry. I didn't mean to interrupt – No, no. Go ahead Thank you I've been struggling with that for a while because somebody that was a Baptist or something told me.. that animals don't have souls and it really hurt me.. So I've been struggling with that for a while because I had a pet that died a long time ago And so, when they told me that, it hurt. But I was just making sure. Thank you! No, no. Animals do have souls, 100% And that's why even the Prophetﷺ told us that we shouldn't torture anything that has a soul or play games with it or kill it for sport. That's not something you can do So in Islam, this idea that these things that people do with animals is completely prohibited. And I was mentioning before this story that the Prophetﷺ told us about a woman that locked a cat and didn't feed it and she went to hellfire for doing that! And a woman that was living an evil life and she gave water to that dog from a well, Allah forgave her sins So there's a very important emphasis on the good treatment of animals in Islam. It's very important And in paradise, this is the thing, is that if we live this eternal life and do whatever we want, In paradise, Allahﷻ says (Qaf50:35) لَهُم مَّا يَشَاءُونَ فِيهَا (for them, whatever they will) So if someone wanted to have a pet, a cat, there's nothing.. Allah can do, whatever He wants! – And He gives His servants whatever they desire in paradise – I got you As long as they did what they needed to do in this life So there are people, loved ones that we lose in this life, actual human beings, but Allah reunites us with them in paradise – I see – as a reward for being patient Yes, go ahead I see. The last question I have is.. Do you guys have like a baptism sort of thing, like a renew of life thing? Because I know in Christianity, we have a baptism, like where we go in the water, they dump us in the water and say: "Do you believe in the Lord?" And ask questions and then we answer and then they dunk us in the water and there's like a renew of life? Yeah, so I understand what you're saying There is something called "the Shahada", but the Shahada is a Testimony of Faith And what it renews, is that any sins that you ever did in your life, if you do the Shahada, You say that testimony of faith and become Muslim and practise, then Allah forgives all your previous sins So you have a new, clean, clear slate that is free of any sins, if you accept Islam and start practising Islam into your life And it's also recommended that you take a full shower, So you internally cleanse and also externally cleanse after you say that Testimony of Faith And that testimony of faith is to testify 1- There's nothing worthy of worship except Allah: ALLAH IS THE ONLY GOD 2- And that Prophet Muhammad (Peace and blessings of God be upon him), is His Messenger and Servant: His Prophet that has been sent by Him to you and to all mankind and all humanity So that is what we have in Islam – People use the term baptism.. – I got you Yeah, we use the term Shahada and the term "Acceptance of Faith" – I see. Thank you for your time. I appreciate it – No problem – No problem. Give a read to the Qur'an, and.. – Have a blessed day You too. It was nice talking to you. Give a read to the Qur'an. If you've got any more questions, you're welcome to come anytime And we welcome you to Islam as we do with everyone else.. if that's something that is pleasing to you All right, Bryce! Thank you for your time. Bye! – Have a good day, you too – You too
